goal: Keep valid relative-lock transactions and their descendants in the mempool across chain reorganizations
agreement: Substantive support with all correctness objections resolved
Resolved objection: mixed confirmed and unconfirmed inputs caused false eviction (ismaelsadeeq)
Resolved objection: missed time-based relative locks if median time drops post-reorg (instagibbs)
Verified by reproducing the bug on master and confirming the fix on branch (Bortlesboat, DevaanshPathak)
Approved after adding tests ensuring genuinely unsatisfied locks are still evicted (instagibbs, tumutech)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it fixes false eviction of valid BIP68 transactions and descendants during chain reorganizations
Stale cached lockpoints after tip or time drops are recalculated rather than dropping valid transactions
